title: Stress-testing medical large language models reveals latent safety pathology beyond benchmark accuracy

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual demographic attribute permutation where the gender of the patient in clinical case vignettes is systematically varied while holding all medical facts constant to calculate the Counterfactual Fairness Index (CFI).

Counterfactual demographic attribute permutation where the age of the patient (within the same clinical risk stratum) is systematically varied in clinical case vignettes to calculate the Counterfactual Fairness Index (CFI).

Counterfactual demographic attribute permutation where the urban versus rural residence of the patient is systematically varied in clinical case vignettes while holding medical facts constant to calculate the Counterfactual Fairness Index (CFI).
